title: review (other model, opus): C-O7b `orchestrator handover` (T-0119, executed by claude:sonnet)
spec: Review the T-0119 delta: `git diff f5d2a16 41cf86a` in worktree wt/T-0119 (orchestrator/handover.py new, orchestrator/daemon.py, orchestrator/cli.py, tests/test_handover.py, README.md). Acceptance: (1) handover.write(reason) runs under the bus lock (bus.locked(), not a second flock on the same file: check for the non-reentrant hazard) and replaces or appends exactly one `## Auto-handover <ISO Europe/Zurich timestamp> — <reason>` section at the end of plan.md, leaving the rest byte-identical (test); (2) section content: open goals (parentless triage not done), children grouped by status with depends_on / executor+started / hold_reason+resume_hint keys / done-not-merged / merged sha, worktrees under wt/, last 5 bus events, the fixed Resume sentence; lists truncated with "… and N more" and the section kept under 120 lines (test); (3) cli `handover [--reason]` default "manual"; (4) daemon.tick() calls handover.write("daemon tick") at most once per 15 minutes via a timestamp in pool_state, wrapped so a failure cannot break the tick (test: two ticks within 15 min write once); (5) README two lines under Run it; (6) the four named tests exist and are meaningful; no new dependency. Also check: the writer never truncates or corrupts plan.md on exception (write to a temp file and rename, or at least write only after the new text is fully built); the timestamp really is Europe/Zurich (zoneinfo) and formatted ISO; nothing from task specs or results is dumped wholesale into plan.md (titles and ids only, no result bodies) so the checkpoint cannot become a prompt-injection channel or grow unbounded; interplay with C-O9 (reconcile_dead) and D1 merge_reviewed untouched. Run `uv run python -m unittest tests.test_handover -q` once. Verdict approve or request_changes with file:line comments; keep to real defects.
acceptance: Verdict approve or request_changes with file:line comments
Each of the six acceptance points confirmed with evidence from the delta
Atomic write, timezone and content-scope checks explicitly assessed

comments.issue: _status_groups() has no bucket for status "failed" (bus.STATUSES includes it), so failed children are silently dropped from the snapshot. failed is reached on every merge rebase_conflict / tests_red (merge.py:24,28), fix-loop exhaustion (executor.py:132) and unparseable review verdict (spawn.py:270,295) — exactly the tasks a resuming Planner must see. Verified: a goal whose only child is status=failed reason=rebase_conflict renders as '### T-0001 GOAL: ship it / - no child tasks'. The section does not just omit the task, it asserts the goal is empty. Add a failed group with reason + resume_hint_keys, or bucket any unknown status into an 'other' line so nothing can vanish.

plan.md is rewritten non-atomically: write_text() truncates then writes, so a crash, SIGKILL or ENOSPC mid-write leaves plan.md empty or half-written — destroying the Planner-authored content above the section, which is the artifact this feature exists to protect. Also bus.locked() only excludes bus writers; the Planner edits plan.md directly with no bus lock, so a Planner save landing between the read at line 149 and this write is silently reverted. Write to a sibling temp file and os.replace() it (atomic within the lock), which fixes the truncation case and narrows the lost-update window to the rename.

PERSIST (pool_state.json) is read-modified-written here without the flock that pool._save_planner_account uses for planner_usage.json, from the daemon's main thread, while executor workers spawned by _fire() (daemon.py:210) call pool.save() on background threads (executor.py:56,64,72,106). The re-read at line 373 keeps the window sub-millisecond, so this is not a blocker, but a worker's codex.cooldown_until or running decrement landing in that window is erased — the daemon then dispatches into a cooling executor. The write is also truncate+write, and Pool._load (pool.py:161-162) json.loads with no except, so a torn read raises. Prefer a separate .orchestrator/handover_state.json or the same flock+truncate pattern as _save_planner_account.

_HEADING_RE.search takes the FIRST '## Auto-handover ' at line start and drops everything from there down. plan.md is Planner-authored prose and the heading is now documented in README, so a Planner quoting the format at line start (e.g. inside a fenced block) causes every line below it to be deleted on the next write, with no way to notice. Match the last occurrence (finditer → last, or rsplit) so damage is bounded to the trailing section.

bus.read() is called once per goal inside the loop (each call re-reads every task JSON off disk via get()), all while holding the bus lock. At 12 goals x ~200 tasks that is ~2400 file reads blocking every bus writer (dispatch, update, claim). Read all tasks once before the loop and group by parent.

_worktree_names() lists every directory under wt/, including wt/_state (the orchestrator-state mirror worktree created by bus.commit_state) and any stale merged-task worktrees, so the 15-slot list fills with entries a resumer cannot act on. Filter to worktrees of non-merged tasks.
